name: GreenNest
description: GreenNest is an eco-friendly plant marketplace where users can explore, buy, and manage plants with a smooth and user-friendly shopping experience.
challenges: Implementing complex inventory management for various plant species.
Optimizing image loading for a smoother shopping experience.
Developing a secure user authentication system with Firebase.

name: Habit Tracker
description: Habit Tracker is a productivity-focused application that helps users build, track, and maintain daily habits consistently.
challenges: Ensuring real-time progress updates without page reloads.
Creating an intuitive UI that motivates daily user engagement.
Managing complex state for daily, weekly, and monthly tracking.

name: ClubSphere
description: ClubSphere is a full-stack platform that allows users to discover clubs, manage events, memberships, and community activities efficiently.
alt: ClubSphere club and event management system
challenges: Building a multi-level user role system (Admin, Member, Visitor).
Syncing event schedules across different time zones for global users.
Implementing real-time notifications for event updates.
